name: moe
description: Moe — a hard fork of the Superpowers ecosystem, one workspace.

scripts.check: pnpm lint && turbo run typecheck test
scripts.mint:check: turbo run mint:generate --force && git diff --exit-code -- plugins && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- plugins)" || (echo '\nplugins/ is not reproducible from source. Regenerate with `pnpm mint` and commit, or move the hand edit into packages/<pkg>/mint/<plugin>.yaml.' && git status --short -- plugins && exit 1)
scripts.tab:test:bindings: pnpm tab:build && uv run --project packages/tab/bindings/python pytest packages/tab/bindings/python
